name: sol9-agent-runtime-proof
goal: Project chat has readable unit references and runtime evidence shows recorded regression proof only after loading

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Project chat must not paint unresolved unit markup. Ready and offline runtime records need realistic proof; pending or absent records must not claim that proof is missing.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Catalog chat intentionally expected a raw unknown id; runtime cases supplied no regression payload and only asserted state notices. Strengthen the same captured states without adding cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record49f923fdbeb45463d448f0a9ad0d4db36788a863fc5aee041a95cfa0605ec15e has12 premature-proof failures and6 ready/offline passes. All18 originals inspected; fixture diagnostic retained separately.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: RuntimeEvidence renders its shared RegressionProof only for loaded records. Default/offline fixtures carry OrderCard proof; project chat uses a readable historical proposal name.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
